articles.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin stated the war in Ukraine is nearing its end. articles.title: Israel Built And Defended A Secret Base In Iraq For Iran War: Report
articles.summary: Israel reportedly constructed and maintained a secret base in Iraq. This facility served special forces and acted as a logistical hub for operations related to Iran. Israel built the installation, which housed special forces and served as a logistical hub.

articles.title: Search for two Singaporeans at Mount Dukono hampered by eruptions and rain
articles.summary: Search efforts for two missing Singaporeans at Mount Dukono are hindered by volcanic eruptions and heavy rain. Local guides are being investigated for leading tourists near the active crater, an area officially closed within a 4km radius.

articles.title: One Dead After Being Hit By Frontier Airlines Plane That Was Taking Off From Denver
articles.summary: A Frontier Airlines plane struck and killed a ground worker during takeoff at Denver International Airport. The incident occurred one day after a Delta Air Lines employee died in a similar accident at Orlando International Airport.

articles.title: Faint Meow In Mississippi Tornado Rubble Leads To Stunning Rescue
articles.summary: A kitten was rescued from tornado debris in Mississippi after its faint meows were heard. The kitten is now safe and has already attracted significant interest from potential adopters. Ashton Lemley says there's already a lot of interest from people who want to adopt the kitten.

articles.title: Vladimir Putin On Russia's War With Ukraine
articles.summary: Putin stated Russia's war with Ukraine needs European governments to make the first move. The Kremlin made this statement last week. The Kremlin said last week that it was for European governments to make the first move.

articles.summary: Eleven people were injured in a suspected boat explosion at a marina in southern Florida. Authorities are currently investigating the cause of the incident. Officials are investigating what caused the explosion at a popular marina in southern Florida.

articles.title: US To Revoke Citizenship Of Indian Man Over $2.5 Million Fraud Case
articles.summary: A U. S. citizen of Indian origin faces citizenship revocation following a $2.5 million fraud conviction. The Department of Justice's Office of Immigration Litigation prosecuted the case. This action targets individuals who obtained citizenship through fraudulent means.

articles.title: Buddhist monk arrested over alleged rape of teen in Sri Lanka
articles.summary: Sri Lankan police arrested Venerable Pallegama Hemarathana Thero, a prominent Buddhist monk, on suspicion of rape. He holds a highly respected position within the global Buddhist community. The arrest follows an investigation into allegations involving a teenager.

articles.title: Indonesian police arrest 321 foreigners in an operation to crack down on banned online gambling
articles.summary: Indonesian police apprehended 321 foreign nationals during an operation targeting illegal online gambling. The crackdown aims to dismantle and prosecute individuals involved in prohibited online betting activities. This operation reflects a broader effort to enforce regulations.

articles.title: Who is Péter Magyar, the man who ended Viktor Orbán’s 16-year rule in Hungary
articles.summary: Péter Magyar has emerged as a significant political figure in Hungary. He is credited with challenging and potentially ending Viktor Orbán's 16-year tenure as prime minister. Magyar's rise signals a notable shift in Hungarian politics.

articles.title: Iran Congratulates Karoline Leavitt On Child's Birth, With A 'Minab' Reminder
articles.summary: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps congratulated Karoline Leavitt on the birth of her child. The congratulatory message included a reminder of the Iranian city of Minab. Leavitt announced the birth of her second child on Thursday.

articles.title: ‘No Kings’ protest outside Buckingham Palace
articles.summary: British anti-monarchists staged a "No Kings" protest outside Buckingham Palace in London. The demonstration occurred on Saturday. Protesters called for an end to the monarchy. British anti-royals have staged a ‘No Kings’ protest outside Buckingham Palace in London.

articles.title: Iran's Guards threaten US Mideast sites as Trump awaits Tehran response
articles.summary: Iran's Guards threatened United States military sites in the Middle East. This action comes as Washington awaits Tehran's response to its latest negotiating position. articles.title: Protests and boycotts rock prestigious Venice Biennale
articles.summary: The 61st Venice Biennale launched on Saturday amid protests and boycotts. Geopolitical tensions marked the opening of the international art event. Attendees called for changes.
